revision_summary: Six quotes in script_coverage carry wrong timestamps (all minor, words exist verbatim elsewhere in the transcript): (1) 'I own the house.' is at 01:22, not 00:26. (2) 'I know for a fact, I've been here five years and the shingles are rotten...' is at 02:27-02:33, not 01:50. (3) 'it's been it's been stable at 500...' is at 03:58-04:04, not 03:37. (4) 'I'm sending it right now.' is at 10:37, not 05:12. (5) '05:00 tomorrow.' is at 07:33, not 06:28. (6) 'Okay. Sounds good.' is at 18:11-18:16, not 17:46. In each case the ts field appears to have been set to the REP's turn that prompted the response rather than the customer's actual reply — a systematic pattern (rep-prompt-ts substituted for customer-response-ts) that the author should correct across all script_coverage rows on rerun, not just these six. Also: reclassify the two 'curiosity_creation_failure' tags (ts 06:09 and 11:00) to schema-appropriate categories — 06:09 belongs under bill_collection.alternative_paths / time_burn_detection, and 11:00 (neighbor social-proof comment) has no clean existing schema hook and should be flagged as a gap rather than force-mapped to curiosity_over_features, which specifically concerns the REP explaining features, not missed customer social-proof callbacks. Additionally, soften the 'genuinely close' framing on the 15:21 reactive-vs-strategic call — schema's explicit 2-minute pivot guidance was violated by a 9+ minute margin, and outcome success (customer self-resolved) shouldn't be used to retroactively validate the rep's late, soft-framed pivot offer. No critical fabrications found; all quoted content exists in the transcript, just at different timestamps than claimed.
